description:
Asks `core_open` for the offline layer. A host sets it as the `layer` key of the text it
gives `core_open`, next to the `CoreConfig` keys. With no `layer` key the core runs alone,
and the core itself never reads this key.

boot_id.description: Names this boot. It changes when monotonic time restarts.

storage_bytes.description: The byte cap from the capability card. 0 means nothing is kept across a restart.

title: LayerConfig
